text:
neha: quick sync — QA ran the fp8/int8 sweep on the customer-facing summarization endpoint and we saw a 4.6% drop in ROUGE-L for long-context cases (>= 8k).

jordan: ouch. what was the config? fallback to int8 or 4-bit?

neha: baseline was fp16 -> fp8 aggressive (activation-only quant) with KV-caching enabled. fallback path was int8 for attention matmul only.

liam: any pattern in failures? hallucination, truncation, or halluc-style factual errors?

neha: mostly verbatim omission + factuality drift on bulleted lists. short prompts fine. failure rate correlates with prefix length and presence of numeric tables.

anna: is this the same dataset we used before? can we reproduce locally with the same seeds?

neha: yes, reproducible. QA ran batch: 10k samples, 3 seeds. attached logs: ```ERROR: deg_score>threshold at step 4823 sample_id=usr_8932
model: fp8-aggr-v3
metrics: rouge_l:-0.046, f1:-0.02, perplexity:+0.3```

jordan: proposal: add a telemetry-driven gate that watches a short-term degradation score and ungates fp8 per-route when score > X for N minutes. keep per-customer grace budgets.

liam: we already have per-route config but not an auto-gate. want a lightweight algorithm suggestion so ops can implement?

neha: simple idea: compute deg_score = weighted(rouge_drop, itm_errors, perplexity_delta) over a sliding window W=1h; if deg_score > 0.03 for 3 consecutive windows, switch route to int8-fallback for that model-version+endpoint for T=30m and mark incident.

anna: can we surface an explain signal so PD/SEs see examples that triggered the gate? a small sample export would help triage.

jordan: yes — capture 10 worst samples + diffed tokens and link to eval-run. ops-bot should also post to #incidents when gate flips.

liam: pseudo-config that ops can use: ```
precision_gate:
  window: 3600
  metrics: [rouge_l_drop, factuality_loss, ppl_delta]
  threshold: 0.03
  consecutive_windows: 3
  fallback: int8-safe
  sample_export: 10
  cooldown: 1800
```

neha: two more constraints: 1) only auto-gate for non-critical enterprise customers if SLO_usage_flag=false; 2) always require manual approval for private deployments.

jordan: agree. add a consumer-facing telemetry flag so customers can opt-out of auto-gating. also add an audit log entry with signed rationale for compliance.

anna: rollout plan suggestion: 1) staging test with synthetic long-context workload; 2) shadow mode for 48h (evaluate triggers but don't flip); 3) enable on 10% of traffic; 4) 100% with monitoring and alerting.

liam: what about cost signal? int8 fallback increases token-cost by ~8%. include cost_penalty in deg_score so we avoid noisy flips for low ROI endpoints.

neha: good call. modify deg_score formula: deg_score = alpha*quality_drop + beta*factuality + gamma*max(0, cost_penalty-weighted). set gamma low (0.1).

jordan: ops-bot note: `@dev-bot` will post to #eng-ml-incidents when gate flips. add runbook: `how_to_rollback_precision_gate` with commands below.

dev-bot: deploy check OK — can run: `rictl precision-gate status --route summarizer-v2` and `rictl precision-gate flip --route summarizer-v2 --to int8-safe --reason \"deg_score 0.045\"` :white_check_mark:

neha: action items: 1) liam to draft the gate code and config schema; 2) anna to prepare synthetic longctx tests; 3) jordan to write eval-export + sample UI; 4) ops to add alert with runbook.

jordan: ack. I'll put a small RFC with the math and example alerts. @liam @anna please ping once you have a first shadow deploy. :eyes:

liam: I'll aim for a shadow deploy next Tues.

neha: thanks — let's keep the gate conservative and observable. :thumbsup:
